name: tell-ai-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the tell-ai CLI, the @tell-ai/sdk browser-safe AI library, the @tell-ai/core shared Node runtime, and the @tell-ai/web sandbox server

scripts.build: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && bun run --filter tell-ai build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk lint && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core lint && bun run --filter tell-ai lint && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web lint
scripts.test:security: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-security.js
scripts.test:context: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-context.js
scripts.test:stream: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-stream.js
scripts.test:mentions: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-mentions.js
scripts.test:cli-adapters: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node --test test/test-cli-core-adapters.js
scripts.test:fuzz: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node --test test/test-fuzz-coverage.js
scripts.test:tellrc: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-tellrc.js
scripts.test:core: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-core-package.js && node test/test-core-browser.js && node --test test/test-core-config.js test/test-core-limits.js test/test-core-loop-feedback.js test/test-core-paths.js test/test-core-project-context.js test/test-core-chain-decision.js test/test-core-runtime.js test/test-core-risk.js test/test-core-exec.js test/test-core-sdk-config.js
scripts.test:core-api: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-core-api.js
scripts.build:core-examples: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun build examples/core/core-node.ts --outdir /tmp/tell-examples --target bun && bun build examples/core/core-bun.ts --outdir /tmp/tell-examples --target bun && bun build examples/core/core-browser.ts --outdir /tmp/tell-examples --target browser && bun build examples/core/core-express.ts --outdir /tmp/tell-examples --target bun
scripts.test:core-examples: bun examples/core/core-node.ts && bun examples/core/core-bun.ts && bun examples/core/core-browser.ts && bun examples/core/core-express.ts
scripts.test:env: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-env.js
scripts.test:runtime: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/core build && node test/test-tell-runtime-limits.js
scripts.test:web: node test/test-web-backend.js && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web build && node test/test-web-sandbox.js
scripts.test: bun run test:sdk && bun run test:core-api && bun run test:env && bun run test:runtime && bun run test:tellrc && bun run test:security && bun run test:context && bun run test:stream && bun run test:mentions && bun run test:cli-adapters && bun run test:fuzz && bun run test:core && bun run test:web
scripts.ci: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test
